record.name: AI Fashion Model Try On Studio
record.offering: Photo & Video app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Create AI fashion model images from your clothing photos. Try-On Studio helps boutiques, brands and online sellers prepare product visuals, catalogs and lookbooks.

LOOKBOOK: START WITH A REFERENCE PHOTO
Explore 550 ready-to-use reference scenes across 22 collections. Choose a photo for its pose, framing and setting, then upload the items you want to change. The reference photo guides the composition, background and lighting.

YOUR PRODUCTS, YOUR CHOICES
Change one item or combine several products. Use a dress instead of separate top and bottom pieces; add shoes, glasses or an accessory. You can also upload a portrait to guide the face and hairstyle. With Smart Styling off, unselected items follow the original reference.

OPTIONAL SMART STYLING
Turn on Smart Styling when adding clothing or shoes to coordinate unselected pieces with your products. It is off by default, so you choose when to use it.

YOUR OWN LOOKBOOK REFERENCES
Add your own reference photos, create collections and save favorites. Keep useful scenes together and return to them for your next collection. Switch between Lookbook tabs while keeping your selections.

PLACES: CHOOSE A MODEL AND LOCATION
Choose from 67 female and male AI models, 40 location backdrops and 14 poses. Use Studio or upload your own location photo for another setting. Places lets you choose the setting and pose separately. In Lookbook, the reference photo supplies the pose and composition.

FLAT LAY PRODUCT IMAGES
Turn hanging garment photos into flat lay compositions for product listings.

SAVE, REUSE AND EXPORT
Keep uploaded products in your libraries and save outfits in Look Library for later use. Resize and arrange generated images, gallery photos or camera shots for product pages, social posts and custom aspect ratios. Save the results to your device.

AI-generated details can vary. Review clothing, colors, textures and logos before publishing a product image.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://emremacit.github.io/fashion-photo-editor-ai/#terms
Privacy Policy: https://emremacit.github.io/fashion-photo-editor-ai/#privacy

record.publisher: PRET A TEMPLATE CRIACAO E COMERCIALIZACAO DE SOFTWARE DE MODA LTDA
record.offering: Graphics & Design app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Bring your fashion design ideas to life, from the first sketch to the finished collection. Prêt-à-Template is a professional fashion design app created for fashion sketching, fashion illustration, outfit design, and product development. Built for students, creatives, stylists, and professional designers, it transforms inspiration into polished fashion concepts with tools designed specifically for the real fashion workflow.

Whether you are learning fashion drawing, building a fashion portfolio, developing a collection, or exploring new styling ideas, Prêt-à-Template offers a complete workspace for modern fashion design. Unlike generic drawing apps, it is built specifically for the needs of the fashion industry, combining fashion sketch tools, realistic templates, visual research, and presentation workflows in one place. It supports both creative exploration and technical development, helping designers move from early concepts to more resolved and presentation-ready ideas with greater speed and confidence.

The app lets you begin creating in two distinct ways, depending on your design style. You can work with linework templates that include front, side, and back guides, making them ideal for structured fashion sketches, technical development, and clean fashion illustration. Or you can start with realistic product templates, working directly over lifelike silhouettes with depth and volume, which is perfect for outfit design, product visualization, and concept development. Puzzle Look makes the creative process even faster and more intuitive. Simply describe the look you want, and it selects the most relevant templates from the library so you can begin designing right away. AI supports your process with fashion-aware suggestions while keeping the designer fully in control of every creative decision.

Prêt-à-Template also includes a flexible mood board workspace where inspiration, materials, styling ideas, and product references can come together naturally. Its integrated fashion library includes fabrics, textile structures, prints, patterns, textures, trims, findings, sleeves, collars, cuffs, pockets, openings, construction details, care labels, and textile symbols, creating a rich environment for research, experimentation, and product thinking. 

The canvas makes fashion sketching feel more expressive, natural, and realistic. You can sketch, shade, annotate, render, and refine using intuitive tools, realistic brush behavior, and a paper-like surface that gives the digital drawing experience a more tactile quality. Prêt-à-Template also uses AI with real fashion context. Its templates are built around garment proportions, silhouette logic, fabric behavior, drape, trims, and construction details, helping deliver results that feel realistic and aligned with professional fashion design workflows rather than generic image generation.

From fashion design and fashion sketching to fashion illustration, outfit design, mood board creation, collection development, styling exploration, textile research, and fashion portfolio building, Prêt-à-Template supports every stage of the fashion design process in one creative workspace, whether you are just starting out or already working at a professional level.

Subscription Pricing & Terms

Prêt-à-Template is free to download. Unlock full access with a yearly or monthly subscription. Auto-renews unless canceled 24 hours before the current period ends.

Manage your subscription in your Apple Account settings.

What Atelia Does
 Generate original fashion designs with AI from moodboards, photos, or simple text descriptions. Automatically convert any design into a structured, production-ready tech pack with clear specifications that factories and manufacturers can easily understand. Discover manufacturers matched to your garment type, order quantity, and budget — all guided by an AI chatbot, no fashion-tech background required.

How It Works
1. Generate your designs with AI – Follow a chatbot and add references to create exactly what you want.
2. Create your tech packs – Get guided through the process to generate a production-ready tech pack.
3. Find a manufacturer – Find the right manufacturer to bring your product to life.
4. Chat directly with them – Make sure they fully understand your idea. Our manufacturers are experts who are ready to advise and guide you.
5. Order your sample and receive it at home – Check that everything is compliant with your expectations and make any necessary adjustments.
6. Start production – Our manufacturers are selected for their low MOQs, so you can start bringing your brand to life right away!

No More
• Paying hundreds of euros for a freelancer to create a tech pack
• Guessing whether your design files are factory-ready
• Losing months between concept and production
• Needing Adobe Illustrator, CLO, or technical fashion design skills

Built For
• Independent fashion designers
• Fashion and apparel startups
• Solo creators launching their first clothing collection
• Emerging brands without an in-house technical design team

Key Features
• AI-powered fashion design generation
• Automated tech pack creation with measurements, construction details, and manufacturing specifications
• Manufacturer and factory sourcing suggestions
•Clean, structured, export-ready files built to real-world manufacturing standards
• End-to-end workflow - moodboard, design, tech pack, manufacturer - all from your phone

Why Atelia?
Big fashion brands have entire technical design teams. Independent creators deserve the same tools. Atelia doesn't replace your creativity - it removes the friction between your idea and the factory floor.

Get Started
Download Atelia and turn your fashion ideas into production-ready designs faster than ever.

Your Personal AI Stylist Just Got Smarter.
See how any outfit looks on you — and get expert AI feedback before you wear or buy it.

AI Try-On: See It On You!
Upload your own photo and any outfit image — dress, suit, or casual look — and watch AI realistically put it on you. Instantly preview how it fits your body and style.

Perfect for online shopping, event planning, or simply discovering what truly suits you.

How It Works

Upload Your Photo & Outfit – Pick from your gallery or snap new ones.

AI Try-On – Instantly see yourself wearing the outfit with realistic precision.

Get AI Analysis – Receive scores, insights, and improvement tips.

Compare Two Outfits – Discover which look wins the style battle.

Realistic Try-On Preview – See how any outfit looks on your body.

Overall Score (1–100) – Get instant style ratings.

First Impression Radar – Romantic, Modern, Classic, Artistic & more.

Style Polar Graph – Bold vs. Modest, Trendy vs. Classic, Minimal vs. Extravagant.

Color & Piece Harmony – See if your outfit truly matches.

Event Match – Find out if your look fits the occasion.

Detailed AI Review – Written analysis with pro-level insights.

Personalized Tips – Step-by-step guidance to improve your outfit.

Outfit Comparisons – Upload 2 looks side by side and see which wins.

Perfect For

Anyone who wants to see outfits on themselves before buying.

Fashion lovers seeking AI-driven outfit ratings and feedback.

People preparing for dates, parties, interviews, or weddings.

Anyone who wants to compare styles and build confidence.

Why StyleMeter?

Unlike basic fashion apps, StyleMeter uses cutting-edge AI to deliver in-depth, visual, and personalized insights.
With realistic AI try-ons, multi-layered analysis, style comparisons, and expert tips, you’ll finally understand why an outfit works (or doesn’t).

Your Style. Upgraded.

Instantly preview outfits on you before you buy or wear them.

Compare two styles and choose your best version.

Learn your unique fashion identity with every analysis.

Boost confidence and make data-backed style choices.

Look your best for every moment — every single day.
Download StyleMeter now and let AI redefine how you see yourself in style.

combinUp – Your AI-Powered Style Assistant!

- combinUp is your smart fashion companion, using AI to suggest the trendiest outfits tailored to your style. It analyzes your wardrobe, helps you manage your outfits, and offers personalized fashion recommendations from top brands across different styles and seasons.
- With combinUp, you can select new fashion pieces within the app or upload your own clothing items to curate your perfect wardrobe. The app learns your preferences over time (like/dislike system) to refine recommendations and match your personal style better.

Smart Shopping & AI Styling
- Before buying an item, see how it fits into your wardrobe! Whether you’re shopping online or in-store, take a photo of a piece you like, upload it, and let combinUp instantly suggest the best outfit combinations for you. No more impulse purchases—shop smarter and more efficiently!

What Can You Do with combinUp?
- AI-Powered Outfit Suggestions – Get the best outfit ideas based on your wardrobe, style, and season.
- Discover & Mix New Pieces – Browse new items and seamlessly integrate them into your outfits.
- Smart Shopping Assistance – See where to buy your favorite pieces and create your shopping list.
- Fashion Community – Share your outfits, get inspired by others, and stay on top of trends!

AI-Generated Outfits
- Discover the best outfit ideas based on the latest trends, seasons, and your personal style.
- Customize your recommendations by liking/disliking suggested outfits.

Try Before You Buy
- Found an item in-store? Snap a photo and upload it to CombinUp!
- Instantly see how it can be styled with your wardrobe before making a purchase.
- Shop smarter by visualizing your outfits in advance.

Your Digital Wardrobe
- Upload your clothes to create a virtual wardrobe.
- Easily organize, mix, and match your items in one place.

Plan for Special Events & Seasons
- Get outfit recommendations for upcoming events and seasonal changes.
- Prepare your wardrobe in advance with AI-powered styling.

Engage with the Fashion Community
- Share your outfits, get feedback, and be inspired by fashion enthusiasts worldwide.
- Explore trending styles and enhance your personal fashion game.

Save & Shop Later
- Like an item? Save it to your favorites and revisit it anytime.
- Never lose track of the pieces you love.

Privacy & Customization
- Keep your profile public to showcase your style, or go private to receive personalized outfit suggestions without sharing.

Upgrade Your Style with AI! Download CombinUp now and transform your fashion game effortlessly!

"Discover Your Style with AI!"

"Elevate Your Fashion with AI!"

Ready to turn your selfies into polished photos and videos? Catwalk is an AI fashion photo and video studio that transforms everyday selfies into editorial portraits, runway walks, high-fashion photoshoots, dance clips, and magazine-style cover looks. No prompt writing required.

Start with one selfie. Pick a style. Let Catwalk create model-inspired photos and short videos for your social posts, stories, profile pictures, or just for fun.

WHAT YOU CAN CREATE
• Editorial Glow — enhance your selfie into a polished, model-like portrait with a more elegant expression, refined lighting, and a premium editorial feel.
• Runway videos — animate your selfie into a realistic, high-fashion catwalk walk.
• Dance clips — create trend-inspired AI dance videos from your photo.
• Model photoshoots — recreate aesthetic looks and outfits as if you were the model.
• AI fashion photos — generate polished fashion, beauty, and catwalk-inspired images from one selfie.
• Cover looks — create magazine-style portraits with a professionally edited feel.
• History — revisit, download, or share your results anytime.

MADE FOR SOCIAL CREATORS
• Photo enhancer flow for cleaner, more stylish portraits.
• Curated stages, outfits, poses, and visual styles.
• Portrait-first composition built for short-form content, stories, and profile photos.
• No complicated prompts or editing skills needed.
• High-quality downloads saved directly to your camera roll.
• New creative styles and outfit drops added regularly.

BEST RESULTS
• Use a clear, well-lit, front-facing selfie.
• Avoid heavy filters, sunglasses, or blurry photos for the cleanest result.
• Make sure your face is clearly visible in the image.
• For Editorial Glow, choose a photo where your face, hair, and outfit are easy to see.

PREMIUM AND CREDITS
• Catwalk Premium gives access to premium image and video generation features.
• Credit packs are available as one-time purchases when you want extra generations.
• You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in Apple ID settings.

PRIVACY AND CONSENT
• You confirm that each uploaded photo is of you, includes no nudity and no minors, and that you have permission to use it.
• Uploads are processed only to generate the output you request.
• You can delete your account and associated media from Settings.

record.name: Awtfit: AI Wardrobe & Stylist
record.offering: Lifestyle app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Awtfit creates a manageable view of your wardrobe by AI-extracting all the clothing items seen in pictures you upload. It then styles you for every day based on the weather and the events in your calendar. You can build your own outfits in the Lab, or prompt the AI to do so, then classify and save them in a manageable view. You can generate photo-realistic previews of yourself wearing any outfit or item you set up in the lab, being able to also prompt the posing and the environment.
Outfit AI also assists with online shopping. You can scan any picture to find dupes of the items observed in different price ranges, then add to your wardrobe as "wishlist" items and operate/style them as you would with one of your item, then buy later on any time. Outfit AI also helps you find your style or compliment your wardrobe with an Explorative engine where you can prompt anything and find items to add as wishlist to your wardrobe, then operate them as you'd wish.
Awtfit is social too: follow friends, browse the closets and calendars they choose to share, send fits in chat, and style each other.
Core features are free with daily limits. Awtfit Pro unlocks unlimited styling and previews, priority processing, scanning and the shopping tools, with a 7 day free trial on the annual plan.
